claims.content: To capture the details of VSP staff and necessary master information while entering the claim into the system.

goal.raw_text: To capture the details of VSP staff and necessary master information while entering the claim into the system.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The system must have the facility to capture the details of VSP staff details and the necessary master information while entering the claim into the system.
The user must be allowed to Add, Modify or delete the VSP master information including payment terms.
The user must have access to the Staff Type Master listing to select the Staff type.
If the selected Staff type is not available in the system, the system must provide the provision to navigate quickly to staff type master to enter the new staff type.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates the process to capture VSP staff details while entering a claim into the system.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the process to capture VSP staff details while entering a claim into the system.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the creation of a new staff member under a VSP.
The system prompts the user to enter mandatory information: VSP Name, Staff Code, Staff Name, and Staff Type.
The user selects the Staff Type from the list of staff type listing from Staff Type Master.
If the selected Staff Type is not available in the system, the system provides the provision to navigate quickly to staff type master to enter the new staff type and then back to Staff Master screen.
The user enters the optional Qualification details for the staff member.
The system automatically creates the Staff Code with Suffix as VSP Code + SC + 3 digit (e.g., HP0001SC0001).
The system validates that all mandatory fields (VSP Name, Staff Code, Staff Name, Staff Type) are completed.
The system checks if a staff member with the existing name already exists.
If a staff member with an existing name is found, the system generates a message but allows the user to save that new staff if required.
The system saves the new VSP staff member details to the database.

If the user selects a Staff Type that is not available in the system, the system provides the provision to navigate quickly to the staff type master to enter the new staff type and then return to the Staff Master screen.
If the system detects that a staff member with an existing name is being created, it generates a message but allows the user to save that new staff if required.

If the user attempts to save a new staff member without completing all mandatory fields (VSP Name, Staff Code, Staff Name, Staff Type), the system shall not allow the record to be saved and shall prompt the user to complete the missing information.
If the user attempts to create a User Group or Individual User with an existing name, the system shall not allow the creation.
The system has captured the details of VSP staff and necessary master information.
A new staff member record is created in the system with a unique Staff Code automatically generated by the system (VSP Code + SC + 3 digit).
All mandatory fields (VSP Name, Staff Code, Staff Name, Staff Type) are stored for the new staff member; Qualification is optional.
If a staff member was created with an existing name, the system allows the save operation to proceed after generating a warning message.
